title: Trainingpeaks Metric0 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), Garmin multisport activities (`garmin:multisport`), TriDot plans (`tridot:plan`), brick workouts (`brick:workout`), and transition logs (`transition:log`).
app: TrainingPeaks structured workouts, Garmin multisport FIT exports, TriDot training plans, brick workout logs, and transition timing notes ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trainingpeaks:metric0
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often trainingpeaks metric0 events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on trainingpeaks metric0 events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It gives you how often your trainingpeaks metric0 exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
